pandas.DataFrame.apply

pandas 3.1.1 · DataFrame · method

Apply a callable to one column at a time by default, or one row at a time with axis=1.

Call syntax

DataFrame.apply(…) Full signature
DataFrame.apply(
    func,
    axis=0,
    raw=False,
    result_type=None,
    args=(),
    by_row='compat',
    engine=None,
    engine_kwargs=None,
    **kwargs,
)
